verdict.rationale: Better Stack's own marketing describes acknowledging incidents "with a single tap" to stop the phone ringing, lists push notifications as an alert channel, and documents acknowledging by pressing 1 during a voice call. Together these show some phone-based acknowledgment, but no source explicitly names a full mobile app or shows escalating or resolving from the phone. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a native mobile app, mobile escalation/reassignment, mobile incident resolution, independent or hands-on corroboration of the mobile experience.

support.subject: As an on-call engineer, a full mobile app lets me acknowledge, escalate, and resolve from my phone at 3am

citations.quote: 30 incidents get created at the same time. Acknowledge them with a single tap and stop your phone from ringing.
Acknowledge them with a single tap and keep your phone from ringing while fixing the issue.
As well as SMS, e-mail, Slack, Teams, and push notifications with our all-you-can-alert pricing.
When Uptime calls you, you are prompted to press 1 to acknowledge the incident.
